messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.reasoning:
We need to calculate entropy change for 1 kg ice heated from 0°C to 100°C at 1 atm. But ice to water at 0°C latent heat, then water heating to 100°C. Also phase change at 100°C? Actually heating to 100°C, not melting or boiling. So we have two processes: melting at 0°C (latent heat of fusion) and heating liquid water from 0°C to 100°C. Pressure 1 atm.

Entropy change ΔS = ∫ dQ_rev/T. For melting: dQ_rev = m * L_fusion. L_fusion of water ~ 334 kJ/kg. At 0°C (273.15 K). So ΔS_melt = m*L_fusion / T = 1 kg * 334000 J/kg / 273.15 K ≈ 1222 J/K.

Then heating water from 0°C to 100°C: ΔS_heat = m * c_water * ln(T_final/T_initial). c_water ~ 4184 J/(kg·K). T_initial=273.15 K, T_final=373.15 K. So ΔS_heat = 1 kg * 4184 J/(kg·K) * ln(373.15/273.15). ln ratio: 373.15/273.15 = 1.366. ln(1.366)=0.312. Multiply: 4184 * 0.312 = 1305 J/K.

Total ΔS_total = 1222 + 1305 = 2527 J/K.

But user asks "多少焦耳/開氏度" i.e., J/K. So answer ~ 2530 J/K.

We should call tool to compute precisely.
